s79: Warns of an approaching railway crossing with a barrier. s85: Warns of an approaching railway crossing without a barrier that has two or more tracks. It is placed immediately before the railway crossing.
s87:
Gives the driver an additional warning, outside built-up areas, of an approaching railway crossing.
Signs 1.4.1−1.4.3 are placed on the right side of the road, and signs 1.4.4−1.4.6 on the left side. s89: Warns that a tram line crosses the road. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s91: An intersection where roads of equal importance cross. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.

s95: Warns of an approaching roundabout marked with sign 4.3. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s97: An intersection, pedestrian crossing or section of road (other than a railway crossing) where traffic is controlled by traffic lights. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s99: Warns of an approaching opening bridge or ferry crossing. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it. s101: The road leads onto a quayside or the bank of a body of water. s103: A dangerous bend to the right with a small radius or limited visibility. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.

s106: 1.13.1. Double bend, first to the right
s107: A section of road with dangerous bends, the first bend being to the right. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s108: 1.13.2. Double bend, first to the left
s109: A section of road with dangerous bends, the first bend being to the left. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s111: Warns of an approaching section of road with a steep descent. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it. If an ascent and a descent (or a descent and an ascent) follow each other, signs 1.14 and 1.15 may be placed without plate 8.1.1, immediately before the ascent and the descent respectively;
s113: Warns of an approaching section of road with a steep ascent. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it. If an ascent and a descent (or a descent and an ascent) follow each other, signs 1.14 and 1.15 may be placed without plate 8.1.1, immediately before the ascent and the descent respectively;
s115: A slippery section of road where the coefficient of tyre grip on the road surface is less than 0.4. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s117: A section of road whose carriageway is damaged: wavy, with potholes, with uneven joints at bridges, etc. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s119: A section of road with an artificial bump built to force vehicles to slow down. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s121: A section of road where crushed stone, gravel, etc. may be thrown up by vehicle wheels. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s123: A section of road where the condition of the roadside does not meet the applicable standards. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s125: A section of road where the carriageway narrows on both sides. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s127: A section of road where the carriageway narrows on the right side. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s129: A section of road where the carriageway narrows on the left side (1.21.3). Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s131: The start of a section of road (carriageway) with two-way traffic, after a section with one-way traffic. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s133: Warns of an approaching pedestrian crossing marked with signs 5.19.1 and 5.19.2 and/or markings 1.14.1–1.14.3. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it. Outside built-up areas the sign is repeated at a distance of at least 50 metres from the start of the hazardous section.
s135: Warns of a children's facility next to the section of road, from which children are likely to appear on the carriageway. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it. Both in and outside built-up areas the sign is repeated at a distance of at least 50 metres from the start of the hazardous section.
s137: Warns of an approaching place where a cycle path marked with sign 4.4 crosses the carriageway. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s139: A section of road where works are in progress. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it. Both in and outside built-up areas the sign is repeated at a distance of at least 50 metres from the start of the hazardous section. For short-term works on the carriageway, the sign is placed 10−15 metres from the work site, without plate 8.1.1.
s141: A section of road passing a livestock shed, a farm and/or a place where livestock (cattle) are regularly driven across, where animals may appear on the carriageway. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s143: A section of road passing a nature reserve, a hunting ground or a forest, or another stretch where wild animals may appear. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s145: A section of road whose carriageway is not protected from avalanches, landslides or falling rocks. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s147: A section of road where a strong crosswind may suddenly blow. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s149: A section of road near an airfield where aeroplanes or helicopters fly at low altitude. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s151: A tunnel with no artificial lighting, or whose entrance portal can be seen from less than 150 metres away because of the terrain. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s153: A section of road that is temporarily blocked by a traffic jam. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s155: A section of road where a danger may arise that is not covered by other warning signs. Outside built-up areas the sign is placed 150−300 metres before the start of the hazardous section, and in built-up areas 50–100 metres before it.
s157: Shows the direction of travel on a small-radius bend with limited visibility (1.35.1−1.35.3 to the right, 1.35.4−1.35.6 to the left), or the direction to take to go around road works.
s159: Shows the direction of travel (right and left) at a T-junction or a fork in the road, or the direction to take to go around road works.
s161: A road on which drivers have priority when passing through uncontrolled intersections. The sign is placed at the start of the road and repeated immediately before every intersection. Sign 2.1 with plate 8.13 is placed, in built-up areas, before an intersection where the main road changes direction; outside built-up areas, in advance, 150−300 metres before the intersection, and also before the intersection itself.
s163: The end of the section of road where it loses its status as a main road. If the main road ends before a crossing with a road that has priority at that intersection, then outside built-up areas sign 2.2 is placed in advance together with sign 2.4, and in built-up areas 25 metres before the intersection and/or together with sign 2.3 or 2.4. The sign may also be placed at another distance, shown on plate 8.1.1.
s165: A road on which drivers must give way to drivers on the road being crossed, or, if plate 8.13 is present, to drivers on the main road. Outside built-up areas sign 2.3 is placed in advance, 150−300 metres before the intersection, with plate 8.1.1 if sign 2.3 is placed before the intersection, or with plate 8.1.2 if sign 2.4 is placed before the intersection. The sign applies to the crossing of carriageways in front of which it is placed.
s167: Prohibits the driver from continuing without stopping at the "Stop" line or, if there is none, at the edge of the carriageway being crossed. The driver must give way to drivers on the road being crossed, or, if plate 8.13 is present, to drivers on the main road. The sign is placed where vehicles on the crossing road cannot be seen well enough. It may also be placed before a railway crossing or a quarantine checkpoint (in this case the driver must stop before the "Stop" line or, if there is none, before the sign). The sign applies to the crossing of carriageways in front of which it is placed.
s169: Prohibits the driver from entering a narrow section of road if this would obstruct traffic coming from the opposite direction. The driver must give way to an oncoming vehicle that is on the narrow section or at its opposite end. The sign is placed immediately before the narrow section of road, or in advance with plate 8.1.1.
s171: Gives the driver priority on a narrow section of road over vehicles coming from the opposite direction. The sign is placed immediately before the narrow section of road.
s173: Prohibits entry in this direction by any kind of vehicle. The sign does not apply to route vehicles.
s175: Prohibits traffic by any kind of vehicle. The sign means that traffic is prohibited in both directions. The sign does not apply to route vehicles. The sign does not apply to a vehicle that serves a business located in the zone concerned, or that serves or belongs to a person who lives or works in that zone. In this case the vehicle enters and leaves the zone at the intersection nearest to its destination. The sign does not apply to a vehicle driven by a person with the status of a significant or severe disability, or to a vehicle carrying such persons.
s177: Prohibits traffic by any kind of motor vehicle. The sign means that traffic is prohibited in both directions. The sign does not apply to route vehicles. In this case the vehicle enters and leaves the zone at the intersection nearest to its destination. The sign does not apply to a vehicle driven by a person with the status of a significant or severe disability, or to a vehicle carrying such persons.
s179: Prohibits traffic by vehicles and combinations of vehicles whose maximum permitted mass exceeds the maximum permitted mass limit shown on the sign. In this case the vehicle enters and leaves the zone at the intersection nearest to its destination.

s183: Prohibits traffic by any kind of tractor and specialised self-propelled machine. The sign means that traffic is prohibited in both directions. s185: Prohibits traffic by any kind of truck or tractor with a trailer, and also the towing of motor vehicles. The sign means that traffic is prohibited in both directions. s187: Prohibits traffic by animal-drawn vehicles, pack animals and riding animals, and also the driving of livestock. The sign means that traffic is prohibited in both directions. In this case the vehicle enters and leaves the zone at the intersection nearest to its destination.
s189: Prohibits traffic by bicycles and mopeds. The sign means that traffic is prohibited in both directions.
s191: Prohibits pedestrian traffic. The sign is placed where pedestrians may not walk for their own safety. The sign applies only to the side of the road on which it is placed.
s193: Prohibits traffic by vehicles and combinations of vehicles whose total actual mass exceeds the figure shown on the sign.
s195: Prohibits traffic by vehicles whose actual load on any axle exceeds the figure shown on the sign.
s197: Prohibits traffic by vehicles whose overall height (with or without a load) exceeds the figure shown on the sign.
s199: Prohibits traffic by vehicles whose overall width (with or without a load) exceeds the figure shown on the sign.
s201: Prohibits traffic by vehicles whose overall length (with or without a load) exceeds the figure shown on the sign.
s203: Prohibits vehicles from driving with a distance between them shorter than the one shown on the sign. The sign applies from the place where it is installed to the nearest intersection, and in a built-up area with no intersection, to the end of the built-up area. The sign also remains in force at exits from adjacent territory and at crossings (junctions) with field, forest and other secondary roads that have no such sign in front of them.
s205: Prohibits passing a customs checkpoint (a customs control zone at the customs border of Georgia) without stopping.
s207: Prohibits any vehicle from continuing because of a road traffic accident or another danger.
s209: Prohibits passing a checkpoint (a police or quarantine post, the entrance to a border or restricted zone, the entrance to a toll road, etc.) without stopping.
s211: Prohibits turning right at the nearest crossing of carriageways. The sign does not apply to route vehicles. The sign applies to the crossing of carriageways in front of which it is placed.
s213: Prohibits turning left at the nearest crossing of carriageways. The sign does not apply to route vehicles. The sign applies to the crossing of carriageways in front of which it is placed.
s215: Prohibits making a U-turn at the nearest crossing of carriageways. The sign does not apply to route vehicles.
s217: Prohibits overtaking any kind of motor vehicle (except vehicles moving slower than 30 km/h). Overtaking motorcycles without a sidecar, mopeds and bicycles is allowed if you do not move into the lane for oncoming traffic. The sign applies from the place where it is installed to the nearest intersection, and in a built-up area with no intersection, to the end of the built-up area. The sign also remains in force at exits from adjacent territory and at crossings (junctions) with field, forest and other secondary roads that have no such sign in front of them.
s219: The end of the zone where road sign 3.20 "No overtaking" applies.
s221: Prohibits trucks with a maximum permitted mass of more than 3.5 tonnes from overtaking other vehicles (except vehicles moving slower than 30 km/h), and also prohibits tractors from overtaking other vehicles (except animal-drawn vehicles and bicycles). The sign also remains in force at exits from adjacent territory and at crossings (junctions) with field, forest and other secondary roads that have no such sign in front of them.
s222: 3.23. End of no overtaking zone for trucks
s223: The end of the zone where road sign 3.22 "No overtaking by trucks" applies.
s225: Prohibits driving faster than the speed (km/h) shown on the sign. s227: The end of the zone where sign 3.24 "Maximum speed limit" applies.
s229: Prohibits using the horn, except when it is used to prevent a road traffic accident. The sign applies from the place where it is installed to the nearest intersection, and in a built-up area with no intersection, to the end of the built-up area. The sign also remains in force at exits from adjacent territory and at crossings (junctions) with field, forest and other secondary roads that have no such sign in front of them. The sign applies only to the side of the road on which it is placed.
s233: Prohibits parking. The sign does not apply to postal vehicles with a white diagonal stripe on a blue background on the body, or to taxis with the taximeter switched on. The sign does not apply to a vehicle driven by a person with the status of a significant or severe disability, or to a vehicle carrying such persons. s234: 3.29. No parking on odd days of the month
s235: Prohibits parking on odd days of the month. When signs 3.29 and 3.30 are used together, vehicles are moved from one side of the road to the other between 19:00 and 21:00 (from 19 to 21 hours). During this period parking is allowed on both sides of the carriageway. The sign does not apply to postal vehicles with a white diagonal stripe on a blue background on the body, or to taxis with the taximeter switched on. The sign does not apply to a vehicle driven by a person with the status of a significant or severe disability, or to a vehicle carrying such persons. The sign applies from the place where it is installed to the nearest intersection, and in a built-up area with no intersection, to the end of the built-up area. The sign applies only to the side of the road on which it is placed.

s237: Prohibits parking on even days of the month. When signs 3.29 and 3.30 are used together, vehicles are moved from one side of the road to the other between 19:00 and 21:00 (from 19 to 21 hours). During this period parking is allowed on both sides of the carriageway. The sign does not apply to postal vehicles with a white diagonal stripe on a blue background on the body, or to taxis with the taximeter switched on. s239: The end of the zone where several of signs 3.16, 3.20, 3.22, 3.24 and 3.26–3.30 apply at the same time.
s241:
Prohibits traffic by vehicles carrying dangerous goods that, under the legislation of Georgia, must display the corresponding identification sign. The sign means that traffic is prohibited in both directions.
The sign is placed to prevent vehicles carrying dangerous, explosive and highly flammable cargo from leaving the route designated for them, and also to prohibit such vehicles from entering a road or area where they pose a particular danger to people.
s242: 3.33. No vehicles carrying explosive and highly flammable cargo
s243:
Prohibits traffic by vehicles carrying explosive and highly flammable cargo of classes 1.22–2.4, 3.1, 3.2 and 5.2 as defined by State Standard 19433-88, which under the legislation of Georgia must display the "Dangerous goods" identification sign. The sign means that traffic is prohibited in both directions.
The sign is placed to prevent vehicles carrying dangerous, explosive and highly flammable cargo from leaving the route designated for them, and also to prohibit such vehicles from entering a road or area where they pose a particular danger to people.
s245: Requires the driver to go straight ahead only. The sign applies to the crossing of carriageways in front of which it is placed; the sign does not apply to route vehicles. When placed at the beginning of a section of road, the sign applies up to the nearest intersection. The sign does not prohibit turning right into a yard or entering other adjacent territory.
s247: Requires the driver to turn right only. The sign applies to the crossing of carriageways in front of which it is placed; the sign does not apply to route vehicles.
